# VoxelCore Content Pack Guide

> Machine-oriented documentation teaching LLMs how to author content packs for
> the VoxelCore voxel engine (github.com/MihailRis/voxelcore): pack manifests,
> folder layout, block/item JSON formats, textures, preload and config files,
> with a step-by-step minimal pack walkthrough and annotated real-world
> examples. Written in imperative DO/AVOID style with trust labels
> (VERIFIED / DOC / OBSERVED). Scope: declarative content, HUD/UI basics,
> entity basics, animations (VCA), sounds & audio and models (VCM/OBJ) —
> projects and worldgen are stub-only.

Start here for the reader contract, trust labels and usage patterns:

- [README](README.md): how to feed this repo to chat LLMs and coding agents

Core reference (01 and 08 are MANDATORY companions to every other file — read
both even if you only need 03 or 09; models that skip them produce broken packs):

- [01 Engine Overview](docs/01-engine-overview.md): MANDATORY prerequisite — terminology, namespaced IDs, ID rules, reserved names, how content loads
- [02 Pack Structure](docs/02-pack-structure.md): package.json manifest, dependencies, content sources, folder layout, config TOML files, enabling packs
- [03 Blocks Reference](docs/03-blocks.md): every documented block property, texture-faces face order, real annotated stock-pack examples
- [04 Items Reference](docs/04-items.md): item properties, icons, generated block items, tags, script boundary
- [05 Textures and Assets](docs/05-textures-and-assets.md): blocks/items atlases, icon.png, preload.json, block materials, localization
- [09 HUD and UI Basics](docs/09-hud-and-ui.md): layouts/, scripts/hud.lua, menu pages (menu.page), overlays (hud.show_overlay), image src addressing
- [10 Entities](docs/10-entities.md): entity JSON definitions (full field table), skeletons, spawn-egg items, entities.spawn, minimal custom components
- [11 Animations](docs/11-animation.md): VCA format (directives, curves, configure), preload naming rules, animation.play, core:animator, verified units and duration semantics
- [12 Sounds and Audio](docs/12-sounds.md): preload entries and the variants pattern, play_sound/play_stream naming rules, channels, speaker control, stream addressing, material sounds
- [13 Creating Audio at Runtime](docs/13-sound-creation.md): PCMStream (feed/share/create_sound), sample format rules, share vs create_sound, mic input pointer
- [14 Models](docs/14-models.md): models/ folder and name resolution, VCM primitives and bones, OBJ subset (no MTL), block/item custom models, entity skeleton binding
- [08 Pitfalls and Checklist](docs/08-pitfalls.md): MANDATORY prerequisite — fatal mistakes, wrong assumptions, pre-flight checklist, debugging hints

Applied:

- [06 Walkthrough: Minimal Pack](docs/06-walkthrough.md): complete working pack built file by file (JSON only, no Lua)
- [07 Example Repos Breakdown](docs/07-example-repos.md): annotated structure of wooden_meat_game and fork_of_kompot, what to copy from each

Out-of-scope stubs (do not guess these topics — pointers to authoritative sources inside):

- [TODO Projects and World Generators](docs/stubs/TODO-projects-worldgen.md)

Full text for pasting into chats:

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): all documents above concatenated in reading order
